raw_text: NDTV — Bangladesh Protests: India Watches Closely as Violence Erupts Near Border, July 15, 2024. New Delhi is monitoring the rapidly deteriorating situation in Bangladesh as anti-quota student protests turn violent across multiple cities. Indian border security forces have been placed on heightened alert along the 4,096-km India-Bangladesh border. Sources in the Ministry of External Affairs confirmed that contingency planning for a potential refugee influx is underway. The protests, which began as a student movement against the government's civil service quota system, have now drawn participation from opposition political parties and labor unions.
